title: Vietnam President To Lam arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, To Lam, arrived in Sri Lanka tonight (07) on a state visit.

title: US military says it intercepted Iranian attacks on 3 Navy ships in Strait of Hormuz
byline: The US military said it intercepted Iranian attacks Thursday on three Navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz and “targeted Iranian military facilities responsible for attacking US forces,” highlighting the fragility of the month-old ceasefire between the two countries.

title: Hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship not start of pandemic, UN health agency says
byline: An outbreak of hantavirus on board a cruise ship is not the start of a pandemic, the UN health agency has said.

title: Federal court rules against new 10% global tariffs Trump imposed after loss at Supreme Court
byline: A federal court ruled Thursday against the new global tariffs that President Donald Trump imposed after a stinging loss at the Supreme Court.

title: US and Iran exchange fire, but Trump says ceasefire still in effect
byline: The United States and Iran exchanged fire on Thursday in the most serious test yet of their month-long ceasefire, but Iran said the situation returned to normal while the U.S. said it did not want to escalate.

title: Heavy rainfall above 100 mm expected in parts of the island
byline: Due to the low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka, the prevailing showery condition over the island is expected to continue during the next few days, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: US-proposed Iran resolution at UN faces likely vetoes from China, Russia
byline: The US on Thursday urged countries to support its United Nations resolution demanding Iran halt attacks and mining of the Strait of Hormuz, but diplomats said China and Russia are likely to veto it.

title: Rajangane Saddharathana arrested over social media threats against Minister and IGP
byline: Rajangane Saddharathana, a person in robes, has been arrested by the Central Crimes Investigation Bureau (CCIB) over allegations of issuing threats through social media against Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala and Inspector General of Police (IGP) Priyantha Weerasuriya, said Police.

title: Explosion hits Netherlands’ largest political party’s headquarters, police say
byline: An explosion damaged the headquarters of the largest party in the Dutch parliament, D66, on Thursday evening, local police said, adding there were no injuries.

title: Vietnamese President To Lam receives official state welcome; Set to address parliament today
byline: The official state reception ceremony for President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam To Lam, who arrived in Sri Lanka yesterday (07) on a two-day official visit, is currently being held today (08).

title: Trump sets July 4 deadline for EU to comply with trade deal or face ‘much higher’ tariffs
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Thursday he would give the European Union until July 4 to implement trade deal commitments before he raises tariffs on EU goods including cars to “much higher levels.”

title: Special medical team to probe fever cases among schoolchildren in Deniyaya
byline: A special team of experts from the Epidemiology Unit of the Ministry of Health is scheduled to visit Deniyaya to investigate the rapid spread of fever among schoolchildren in the area, according to District Director of Health Services Sumith Manatunga.

title: Former SriLankan CEO Kapila Chandrasena found dead - Police
byline: Former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, was found dead at a residence in Colpetty, according to Police.

title: Vietnam President To Lam addresses Sri Lanka’s Parliament
byline: President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, To Lam, who arrived in Sri Lanka on a two-day official visit, is currently addressing the Parliament of Sri Lanka.

title: Vietnam donates 100MT of fertiliser to Sri Lanka
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stated that the Government of Vietnam has donated 100 metric tons of urea and superphosphate fertiliser to Sri Lanka.

title: SC orders re-issuance of notice to ex-President Gotabaya Rajapaksa
byline: The Supreme Court today directed the petitioning party to take steps to reissue notice to former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa, who has been named as a respondent in a Fundamental Rights (FR) petition.

title: Sri Lanka and Vietnam sign five MoUs during state visit of President To Lam
byline: Following the official state ceremony held to welcome the President of Vietnam, To Lam, who is currently undertaking a two-day official visit to Sri Lanka, several Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) were signed between the two countries.

title: Sri Lanka and Vietnam aim for $ 1B trade by 2030, direct flights to begin this year
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake announced that Vietnam Airlines will commence direct flights between Sri Lanka and Vietnam within this year.

title: Police report facts to court over ‘suspicious’ death of Kapila Chandrasena
byline: Police have informed the Fort Magistrate’s Court that former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, was found dead under suspicious circumstances.

title: Seven suspects arrested over drug network linked to ‘Dubai Sudda’
byline: Bandaragama Police have arrested seven suspects, including the alleged key distributor linked to the drug trafficking network of the notorious large-scale drug trafficker known as ‘Dubai Sudda’, following a raid conducted at a suspected drug packaging location.

title: Presidential Commission probing coal imports begins investigations
byline: The Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry appointed to investigate coal procurement between 2009 and April 16, 2026, has commenced its preliminary investigations.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-Western, North-Central, Uva, and Southern provinces, as well as the Ampara, Batticaloa, Mannar, and Vavuniya districts.

title: SLPP questions circumstances surrounding Kapila Chandrasena’s death
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) General Secretary, Sagara Kariyawasam, claims that the death of former SriLankan Airlines CEO Kapila Chandrasena seems suspicious.

title: Yoshitha’s money laundering case: Court to deliver decision on preliminary objections
byline: The Colombo High Court today (08) announced that its ruling on the preliminary objections raised in the case filed under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act against Yoshitha Rajapaksa, a son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, will be delivered on May 14, 2026.

title: David Attenborough turns 100, ‘overwhelmed’ by birthday wishes
byline: David Attenborough said he had been “completely overwhelmed” by birthday greetings as he turned 100 on Friday in a worldwide outpouring of affection for the British wildlife broadcaster after decades of trailblazing work.

title: Fever outbreak in Deniyaya identified as viral infection: Health officials
byline: Health authorities say that a fever illness reported around the Kotapola Medical Officer of Health (MOH) area has been identified as a viral infection, according to Specialist Dr. Palitha Karunapema of the Epidemiology Unit of the Ministry of Health.

title: Public Security Minister speaks on probe into Kapila Chandrasena’s death
byline: Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala stated that no definitive conclusion can be made at this stage regarding the death of former SriLankan Airlines CEO Kapila Chandrasena.

title: 88-year-old woman found murdered in Tissamaharama
byline: Two people, including a woman, have died in separate incidents suspected murder reported from Pitigala and Tissamaharama areas.

title: South Africa’s top court revives impeachment process against president
byline: South Africa’s constitutional court revived on Friday impeachment proceedings against President Cyril Ramaphosa over a scandal dubbed ‘‘Farmgate’’ by local media, saying parliament had acted unlawfully by blocking the process in 2022.

title: Vietnam and Sri Lanka elevate ties to ‘comprehensive partnership’ to boost trade, AI and tourism cooperation
byline: The President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, Tô Lâm, who is on an official visit to Sri Lanka, announced that Vietnam and Sri Lanka have agreed to strengthen bilateral relations to a ‘‘Comprehensive Partnership...’’

title: TVK secures majority mark as Left, VCK extend support to Vijay
byline: The Communist Party of India and the Communist Party of India (Marxist) have on Friday decided to extend outside support to the government formation following the hectic efforts made by the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), led by actor-politician Vijay.

title: Kurunegala Deputy Mayor arrested over Rs. 3 million bribe
byline: The Deputy Mayor of Kurunegala Municipal Council, Ashardeen Moinudeen, has been arrested by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) for allegedly soliciting a bribe of Rs. 3 million to award a tender to a businessman.

title: Sony forecasts lower gaming business sales amid memory price surge
byline: Sony forecast on Friday annual sales at its gaming business would fall 6% to 4.42 trillion yen ($28 billion) due to lower hardware sales as its PlayStation 5 ages and as the industry grapples with a surge in memory chip prices.

title: 3 people burned alive as volcano erupts in Indonesia, ash rises 10 km high
byline: In a tragic incident that occurred in Indonesia, at least three people were burned alive when Mount Dukono volcano erupted suddenly.

title: US expects Iranian response to peace proposal on Friday, fighting flares in Gulf
byline: The United States said it expected an Iranian response as soon as later in the day on Friday to its latest proposal to end the war in the Gulf, even as U.S. and Iranian forces clashed in the Gulf and the United Arab Emirates came under renewed attack.

title: PM Harini and Vietnam President hold talks to boost bilateral cooperation
byline: A bilateral meeting between Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya and President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, To Lam, who is on a state visit to Sri Lanka, has been held this afternoon (08) at the Hilton Colombo.

title: Vietnamese President Tô Lâm concludes state visit to Sri Lanka
byline: The delegation led by Tô Lâm, President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam and General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam has departed Sri Lanka, a short while ago, from the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)...

title: Sri Lanka–Vietnam Trade, Investment and Tourism Forum held in Colombo
byline: Marking a significant milestone in strengthening bilateral relations between Sri Lanka and Vietnam , the Sri Lanka– Vietnam  Trade, Investment and Tourism Cooperation Forum was successfully held today (08) at the Hilton Colombo.

title: Pakistani, Sri Lankan armies conclude two-week joint counterterror exercise ‘Shake Hands II’
byline: Pakistani and Sri Lankan armies on Thursday concluded a two-week joint counter-terror exercise “Shake Hands II” in the northwestern Tarbela city, the Pakistani military’s media wing said, noting that the event was aimed to harnessing military-to-military ties between both nations.

title: Several homes inundated in Wellawaya as Kirindi Oya water levels rise rapidly
byline: Heavy rainfall accompanied by torrential downpours has been reported since this afternoon (08) in the catchment areas of Wellawaya and the Kirindi Oya, resulting in a rapid rise in the water levels of the Kirindi Oya.
